newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Two bidders sign up for Venezuela Hotel Melia sale.
newsitem.headline: Two bidders sign up for Venezuela Hotel Melia sale.

text.p: Two companies have registered their firm interest in participating in Friday's planned sale of Venezuela's unfinished hotel and shopping complex Hotel Melia, a top government official said Tuesday.

U.S. company Entertainment Resorts Development International and Switzerland's C.S.L. Credito Subalpino Di Lugano, presented the necessary requirements to take part in the sale, said Roberto Piol, vice president of real estate at state-owned Banco Industrial. Banco Industrial owns the hotel complex.
It will be the third attempt to sell the hotel complex, for which a 15.409 billion bolivar ($32.6 million) base price has been set.
Construction of the complex started in 1987, but ground to a halt in 1994 when the then-owner could no longer meet bank payments and the property was transferred to Banco Industrial.
